title: Izn Dukhul: Permission to Enter a Shrine
intro: The source collection’s entrance prayers and salutations for approaching the holy shrines.
description: Read Izn Dukhul: Permission to Enter a Shrine with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
ASKING PERMISSION FOR ENTERING THE HOLY SHRINES

Two forms of asking permission for entering the holy shrines (isti’dhan).

First: In the word of Shaykh al-Kaf`ami, when you intend to enter the Holy Prophet’s Mosque in al-Madinah or any of the holy shrines of the Imams (‘a), you may say the following:

blocks.english: O Allah, I am standing at one of the doors
of Your Prophet’s Houses—
may Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: وَقَدْ مَنَعْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ انْ يَدْخُلُوٱ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa qad mana`ta alnnasa an yadkhulu illa bi'idhnihi
blocks.english: And You have prevented people to enter there before they obtain his permission.
You have thus said, “O ye who believe!

blocks.arabic: لاََ تَدْخُلُوٱ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ انْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ“
blocks.transliteration: la tadkhulu buyuta alnnabiyyi illa an yu'dhana lakum
blocks.english: Enter not the Prophet's houses until leave is given you.”

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعْتَقِدُ حُرْمَةَ صَاحِبِ هٰذَا ٱلْمَشْهَدِ ٱلشَّريفِ فِي غَيْبَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni a`taqidu hurmata sahibi hadha almashhadi alshsharifi fi ghaybatihi
blocks.english: O Allah, I believe in the sanctity of the owner of this holy shrine in his absence
as same as I believe in it in his presence.

blocks.arabic: وَاعْلَمُ انَّ رَسُولَكَ وَخُلَفَاءَكَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
blocks.transliteration: wa a`lamu anna rasulaka wa khulafa'aka `alayhimu alssalamu
blocks.english: I also know for sure that Your Messenger and Your Representatives—peace be upon them—
are live, finding their sustenance in the presence of You;
they can see my place,
hear my words,
and respond to my greetings,
but You have prevented my hearing from receiving their words

blocks.transliteration: wa fatahta baba fahmi biladhidhi munajatihim
blocks.english: and You have opened the door of my understanding to taste the fine flavor of my confidential speech with

blocks.transliteration: wa inni asta'dhinuka ya rabbi awwalan
blocks.english: I thus ask Your permission—O my Lord—first of all,

blocks.arabic: وَاسْتَاذِنُ رَسُولَكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ثَانِياً
blocks.transliteration: wa asta'dhinu rasulaka salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi thaniyan
blocks.english: the permission of Your Prophet—peace be upon him and his Household—secondly,
the permission of Your Representative, the Imam
the obedience to whom is incumbent upon me…

blocks.text:
Mention the name of the Imam that you are visiting his holy shrine and also mention the name of his father. For instance, if you are visiting the holy shrine of Imam al-Husayn (‘a), you may say, “al-Husayn ibn `Ali—peace be upon him.” And if you are visiting the holy shrine of Imam al-Rida (‘a), you may say, “`Ali ibn Musa al-Rida—peace be upon him” and so on.

You may then say:

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ ٱلْمُوَكَّلينَ بِهٰذِهِ ٱلْبُقْعَةِ ٱلْمُبَارَكَةِ ثَالِثاً
blocks.transliteration: walmala'ikata almuwakkalina bihadhihi albuq`ati almubarakati thalithan
blocks.english: …and the permission of the angels whom are commissioned to supervise this blessed area, thirdly.
May I enter, O Messenger of Allah?
May I enter, O Argument of Allah?
May I enter, O angels of Allah—the intimate,
the residing in this shrine?

blocks.arabic: فَاذَنْ لِي يَا مَوْلاَيَ فِي ٱلدُّخُولِ
blocks.transliteration: fa'dhan li ya mawlaya fi alddukhuli
blocks.english: So, (please do) permit me to enter, O my Master,

blocks.arabic: افْضَلَ مَا اذِنْتَ لاِحَدٍ مِنْ اوْلِيَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: afdala ma adhinta li'ahadin min awliya'ika
blocks.english: in the best way of permission that you have ever conferred upon any of your intimate adherents.
If I do not deserve such permission,
then you are worthy of conferring it upon me.

blocks.text: You may then kiss the holy doorstep (of the shrine) and enter, saying:

blocks.english: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
on the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the norm of the Messenger of Allah,
may Allah bless him and his Household.
O Allah, (please do) forgive me,
have mercy upon me, and accept my repentance,
for You are verily the Oft-Returning, the All-Merciful.

blocks.text:
Second:
Following is the form of asking permission that is reported by `Allamah al-Majlisi—may Allah sanctify his soul—from an old copy of a book written by one of our old scholars who had mentioned that it is a form of asking permission to enter the Holy Vault (Sirdab) and the illuminative shrines of the Holy Imams (‘a):

blocks.english: O Allah, this is verily an area that You have purified,
a courtyard that You have honored,
and landmarks that You have ennobled
when You have shown therein the proofs on Your Oneness
and the ghosts of the Glorious Throne
whom You have selected as kings maintaining the System (of the universe),
You have chosen them as chiefs of all beings,
and You have sent them for standing out firmly for justice

blocks.arabic: فِي ٱبْتِدَاءِ ٱلْوُجُودِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
blocks.transliteration: fi ibtida'i alwujudi ila yawmi alqiyamati
blocks.english: since the beginning of existence and up to the Resurrection Day.
You have then conferred upon them with the grace of their representing Your Prophets
in the matters of maintaining Your rules and laws.
You have thus perfected, through assigning them as successors of Your Prophets, the Mission of the warning Prophets

blocks.arabic: كَمَا اوْجَبْتَ رِيَاسَتَهُمْ فِي فِطَرِ ٱلْمُكَلَّفِينَ
blocks.transliteration: kama awjabta ri'asatahum fi fitari almukallafina
blocks.english: in the same way as You have made their leadership incumbent since the first creation of all peoples who are responsible for carrying out Your duties.
Glory be to You; what a Compassionate Lord Your are!

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ مِنْ مَلِكٍ مَا اعْدَلَكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa anta min malikin ma a`dalaka
blocks.english: There is no god save You; what a Just King You are!

blocks.arabic: حَيْثُ طَابَقَ صُنْعُكَ مَا فَطَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعُقُولَ
blocks.transliteration: haythu tabaqa sun`uka ma fatarta `alayhi al`uqula
blocks.english: Your making has corresponded with all that on which You have created the intellects,

blocks.arabic: وَوَافَقَ حُكْمُكَ مَا قَرَّرْتَهُ فِي ٱلْمَعْقُولِ وَٱلْمَنْقُولِ
blocks.transliteration: wa wafaqa hukmuka ma qarrartahu fi alma`quli walmanquli
blocks.english: and Your laws have concurred with that which You have decided, including the logic and the narrated.

blocks.arabic: فَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ تَقْدِيرِكَ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلْجَمِيلِ
blocks.english: Praise be to You for Your arrangement—the fine and excellent.

blocks.arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلشُّكْرُ عَلَىٰ قَضَائِكَ ٱلْمُعَلَّلِ بِاكْمَلِ ٱلتَّعْلِيلِ
blocks.transliteration: wa laka alshshukru `ala qada'ika almu`allali bi'akmali altta`lili
blocks.english: Thanks be to You for Your ordain that is outstandingly founded.

blocks.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاََ يُسْالُ عَنْ فِعْلِهِ
blocks.english: Glory be to Him Whom is not asked about whatever He does,
and Whom is not disputed about whatever He decides.

blocks.arabic: وَسُبْحَانَ مَنْ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ
blocks.transliteration: wa subhana man kataba `ala nafsihi alrrahmata
blocks.english: Glory be to Him Who has inscribed mercy for Himself
before He started creation.
Praise be to Allah Who has conferred upon us
with the favor of assigning rulers who represent Him
as if He is present therein.

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي شَرَّفَنَا بِاوْصِيَاءَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la ilaha illa allahu alladhi sharrafana bi'awsiya'a
blocks.english: There is no god save Allah Who has honored us with Successors
maintaining the (Divine) laws in all ages.
Allah is the Most Great for He has demonstrated them before us
through miracles that neither men nor can the jinn do.

blocks.arabic: لاََ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظيمِ
blocks.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
blocks.english: There is no power and no might save with Allah, the Most High, the All-great,

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّذِي اجْرَانَا عَلَىٰ عَوَائِدِهِ ٱلْجَمِيلَةِ فِي ٱلامَمِ ٱلسَّالِفينَ
blocks.transliteration: alladhi ajrana `ala `awa'idihi aljamilati fi al'umami alssalifina
blocks.english: Who has accustomed us to receive His favorable donations that He did to the ancient nations.
O Allah, all praise be to You and elevated thanks be to You
as eternal existence has been confirmed for Your Face,

blocks.transliteration: wa kama ja`alta nabiyyana khayra alnnabiyyina
blocks.english: and as You have chosen our Prophet to be the best of Prophets
and our kings to be the best of the creatures,
and You have chosen them aforetime above the nations knowingly.

blocks.arabic: وَفِّقْنَا للِسَّعْيِ إِلَىٰ ابْوَابِهِمُ ٱلْعَامِرَةِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
blocks.transliteration: waffiqna lilssa`yi ila abwabihim al`amirati ila yawmi alddini
blocks.english: (Please do) grant us prosperity to stand at the doorsteps of their flourishing shrines up to the Resurrection Day,

blocks.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ ارْوَاحَنَا تَحِنُّ إِلَىٰ مَوْطِئِ اقْدَامِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: waj`al arwahana tahinnu ila mawti'i aqdamihim
blocks.english: make our souls long for the places of their feet,

blocks.arabic: وَنُفُوسَنَا تَهْوَىٰ النَّظَرَ إِلَىٰ مَجَالِسِهِمْ وَعَرَصَاتِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa nufusana tahwa alnnazara ila majalisihim wa `arasatihim
blocks.english: and make our spirits desire for looking at their sessions and courtyards

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ كَانَّنَا نُخَاطِبُهُمْ فِي حُضُورِ اشْخَاصِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: hatta ka'nnana nukhatibuhum fi huduri ashkhasihim
blocks.english: as if we can talk to them in their presence.

blocks.arabic: فَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سَادَةٍ غَائِبينَ
blocks.english: May Allah bless them; they are absent masters,
immaculate progeny,
and infallible leaders.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَاذَنْ لَنَا بِدُخُولِ هٰذِهِ ٱلْعَرَصَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma fa'dhan lana bidukhuli hadhihi al`arasati
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) permit us to enter these courtyards

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّتِي ٱسْتَعْبَدْتَ بِزِيَارَتِهَا اهْلَ ٱلارَضِينَ وَٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: allati ista`badta biziyaratiha ahla al-aradina walssamawati
blocks.english: that You have ordered the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth to visit them as sign of worship to You,
make our eyes shed tears of reverence for their dignity,

blocks.arabic: وَذَلِّلْ جَوَارِحَنَا بِذُلِّ ٱلْعُبُودِيِّةِ وَفَرْضِ ٱلطَّاعَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa dhallil jawarihana bidhulli al`ubudiyyati wa fardi altta`ati
blocks.english: and make our organs show humility of servitude and of obligatory obedience (to You),

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ نُقِرَّ بِمَا يَجِبُ لَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوْصَافِ
blocks.transliteration: hatta nuqirra bima yajibu lahum min al-awsafi
blocks.english: so that we will confess of the qualities that are fixed for them
and to admit that they are the interceders for the creatures

blocks.arabic: إِذَا نُصِبَتِ ٱلْمَوَازِينُ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلاعْرَافِ
blocks.transliteration: idha nusibat almawazinu fi yawmi al-a`rafi
blocks.english: when the Scale shall be set up on the Heights Day.

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi wa salamun `ala `ibadihi alladhina istafa
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah and peace be upon His servants that He has chosen;
Muhammad and His Immaculate Household.

blocks.text: You may then kiss the doorstep with submission and teary eyes, for this is the sign that you have been permitted by the Infallibles—peace be upon them—to enter.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ اذن دخول کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
